instruction: Transform the LibreOffice Impress slides into a Flash animation and play it in Firefox.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Impress does not support exporting presentations as Flash (.swf) files, and Flash is deprecated and no longer supported by modern browsers.
